name: LA LA LOU
source:
You dumped your now ex-girlfriend Angie, who has disappeared after spamming your calls and text messages for weeks on end. It is today that she decides to show up at your job... To talk about her issues? Seriously?

[From [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/la-la-lou]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你甩了你现在的前女友安吉，她在连续几周给你打电话和发短信后失踪了。今天她决定出现在你的工作场所……谈论她的问题？严重地？

[来自[url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/la-la-lou]itch.io[/url]]
